```sql
WITH school_records AS (
    SELECT f."School Type",
           COALESCE(f."School Name", s.School) AS "School Name",
           s.Latitude,
           COALESCE(f."School Type", s.SOCType) AS type_for_matching,
           ' ' || LOWER(COALESCE(f."School Name", s.School)) || ' ' AS name_for_matching
    FROM schools AS s
    LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.State = 'CA'
), middle_schools AS (
    SELECT "School Type", "School Name", Latitude
    FROM school_records
    WHERE type_for_matching IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)', 'Junior High Schools (Public)')
       OR (name_for_matching GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]middle[^a-z0-9]*'
           AND name_for_matching NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]middle college[^a-z0-9]*')
       OR name_for_matching GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]intermediate[^a-z0-9]*'
       OR name_for_matching GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]junior high[^a-z0-9]*'
       OR name_for_matching GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]jr. high[^a-z0-9]*'
       OR name_for_matching GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]jr high[^a-z0-9]*'
)
SELECT "School Type", "School Name", Latitude
FROM middle_schools
WHERE Latitude = (SELECT MAX(Latitude) FROM middle_schools);
```
